name: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key
statusNote: New in Forever. Its level is not known yet. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: <With the undead hordes endlessly gathering nearby and no sign of others, you choose to make use of your Silver Skeleton Key to effortlessly open the chest. Despite the claims of impressive riches, the trunk is nearly empty. At the very least there is enough present to cover some of the cost of this ordeal.>
narrative.requestItemsText: <After following the instructions on the writ, you find yourself deep in a crypt surrounded by undead. There is a note on a nearby trunk.> Whomever first reads this will be the first to learn of my death. I am a mere caretaker of the Raven Hill Cemetery, whose presence is largely forgotten by even his employers at Darkshire. I have no heir with which to bestow my vast wealth unto. I have since stashed them away, in this box, for who or whatever manages to open it.
